name: When should I consider remodeling for an accessible bathroom?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider remodeling for an accessible bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider remodeling for an accessible bathroom proactively before an immediate need arises, such as when planning for aging in place or anticipating future mobility challenges. It's also appropriate if a family member's mobility changes, or if you simply want to enhance the long-term safety and usability of your home. Early planning allows for thoughtful design integration and avoids rushed decisions during a crisis. Many homeowners also choose to remodel if they are renovating their entire home to ensure consistent design and accessibility throughout.
